column1: # setters.tsv: boot on an empty NVS (init), call one setter with one input, record the effect. The setter name is the vocabulary of the README. Columns: op, setter, input (-: n/a), return, listener events fired during the call (- = none), NVS value writes during the call, NVS commits during the call, the NVS entry for the setter's key after the call (key:type=value), all getters after the call.
